response.sql: WITH u AS (SELECT zoneref, articount FROM scanfeatures), t AS (SELECT SUM(articount) AS total FROM u), s AS (SELECT u.zoneref, u.articount, CAST(u.articount AS REAL) / t.total AS share FROM u CROSS JOIN t WHERE t.total IS NOT NULL AND t.total <> 0), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT s.zoneref AS site_code, s.articount AS artifact_count, s.share AS share, s.share - a.avg_share AS share_minus_avg FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE a.avg_share IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (s.share - a.avg_share) IS NULL, (s.share - a.avg_share) DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Each scanfeatures row is one unit; the zoneref column is the site code shown.
A total of zero is treated like a missing total (division would be undefined), so no rows are returned.
Units with a missing articount have a missing share. They are kept in the output with NULL share and difference, and sort last. They are excluded from the total and the average.
